page.layout: One block of text at full width: heading PRAEFATIO at top, then a paragraph of running text, a date line, then an engraved ornament (woodcut device) in the centre and a signature "JOH." below it. No running head, page number, catchword or signature mark printed.

main_text.head: PRAEFATIO.
main_text.p: gerrimi amici, divinum hoc studium, & me cum illo, sicuti coepistis, amare pergite. Sic Deus vitae studiisque vestris in inclyta Geneva ubertim benedicat, reliquumque vestrum iter Gallicanum prosperet, ut salvi & incolumes dulce natale solum tandem revisatis. Scripsi Basileae 16. Novemb. Ann. 1612.

page.notes: The first word of the paragraph is a large initial "G" joined to "gerrimi" (rendered as "gerrimi", reading "Dilectissimi" is not legible; the initial is printed as a decorative letter and is reproduced as shown). The date "1612" is set in the printed form "Ann. 1612" with a numeral 16 before "Novemb.". The engraving is an ornamental woodcut device with scrollwork, not transcribed as text. Scan shows faint marks and show-through, omitted.
